offering_description.value: HealthStream sells cloud software and training to hospitals, health systems, and other healthcare organizations. Its platforms help customers train staff, track competencies and compliance, verify clinician credentials, manage clinical privileges, and schedule staff.

primary_products.value: Learning and competency management software; clinical and compliance training courses; credentialing and privileging software; workforce scheduling software; provider enrollment software

primary_services.value: Credential verification; software implementation and configuration

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, health systems, physician groups, and post-acute care providers; B2G: Public hospitals and government-operated healthcare systems; B2C: Healthcare professionals buying continuing education and training

end_markets.value: Hospital and acute care; ambulatory care; post-acute and long-term care; healthcare professional education

revenue_model.value: subscription: Access to cloud software and course libraries; service fees: Credential verification and software implementation; product sales: Individual online courses and training materials

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Combines workforce software with proprietary and partner training content for healthcare organizations; service provider: Verifies clinician credentials for healthcare organizations using records from primary sources

geography_served.value: US national: Healthcare organizations across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Healthcare learning, competency management, credentialing, privileging, provider enrollment, and staff scheduling

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving hospitals, health systems, and other healthcare providers; online: Company storefront for individual courses and training materials

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Data privacy rules for workforce and provider records, plus healthcare accreditation standards that shape credentialing workflows

notes: The extent of sales outside the United States is uncertain.
